lines.en: Zelos...  we've got to reach Antares's base before the Imperial Army.
lines.zh: 泽洛斯…… 我们要赶在帝国军队之前到达安塔瑞斯的大本营。

lines.en: ...Why? You want mercy for the defeated, don't you?
lines.zh: ……为什么？你不想杀死他们，对吧？
lines.name: 泽洛斯

lines.en: Your tale about the Crimson Star's got me on edge.  I just have a gut feeling.  Come on, you've used that excuse dozens of times with me.
lines.zh: 你那关于猩红之星的传说让我有些紧张。 我只是有种预感。 拜托，你自己不知多少次用这个借口劝过我了。

lines.en:
True, Protagonist. Maybe we can convince them to lay down their arms.
True, Protagonist.  Very well, I think it's time to consider the "Force Surrender" attack.  Instead of destroying the enemy outright, we can force a demoralized Squad to surrender.  Surrender still removes the squad from the battlefield, but it allows us to ransom Prisoners of War for more funds.  Try to force the Surrender of one of these enemies while they are weakened - I see a very frightened squad in my range right now.
lines.name: 泽洛斯

lines.en: Now let's show Casamir's army who's the real elite vanguard of Veridia.
lines.zh: 现在，让卡萨米尔的手下看看，谁才是维尔迪亚真正的精锐前锋。
lines.name: 泽洛斯

lines.en:
Protagonist, as we've seen, Weather is a factor in this war.  Weather can sometimes present new obstacles to everyone on the battlefield.  Storms make firearms ineffective and make Lightning Mages more powerful, Blizzards slow down movement and make Ice Mages more powerful, and more.
Protagonist, see that tent? That's a Bazaar.  While our Home Base allows us to purchase equipment or hire mercenaries, the Bazaar does the same but will have higher-quality, rarer choices.  We should try to reach Bazaars whenever we can - there might be a very lucky find waiting for us.
lines.name: 泽洛斯
